---
title: "Chord Grid by Ear"
description: "A recording under a blank chord grid: play any bar, loop a few, type the chords you hear, and check them against the tune."
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<script src="/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js?v=3"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/mlt/recordings.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/mlt/ear-grid.js?v=1"></script>
```

Learn a tune's chords (and melody) from a recording. Each box is one bar: **click** it to play from there, **Shift+click** a
second bar to loop the bars between, **Space** plays and pauses. Type what you hear in each bar: a chord name (`C`, `G7`,
`Am`) or a Roman numeral (`I`, `V7`, `vi`); two chords in a bar go in with a space between. **Check** colours each bar:
green right, orange the right root but another chord, red wrong. Checking needs the recording to be linked to a tune with
chords (see the [Recordings Catalogue](/mlt/recordings.html)); chords are compared by function, so a recording in D is
checked against notation in C. Set **Key** to the key the recording is in when you type chord names. Underneath, the
tune's notation (in the recording's key) checks the melody.

The bars come from the recording's timing map when it has one (made in [Timestamp Notes](/tools/timestamp-notes.html)).
Without one, set where the first bar starts (play to the first downbeat and press **= now**), tap the tempo, and the grid
is drawn at that steady tempo. Your guesses are kept in this browser, for each recording.

```{=html}
<div class="ear-grid"></div>
```
